readerCopy.headline: Put your name on it.
readerCopy.body:
A project or role that once felt too big may feel like yours to claim now. You may be more willing to lead, submit the work, take credit, or say what you actually want next. Other people may notice the shift before you have found a polished explanation for it.

Jupiter conjunct Sun can make confidence useful and contagious. Let yourself be seen. Just keep the promise sized to the work you can actually deliver. Recognition feels better when the role does not require you to become permanently available to everyone who noticed.
doNotAssume: Do not assume fame, leadership, a promotion, or that visibility is always wanted.
